html:
.root {
  container-type: inline-size;
  container-name: component-selection;
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px;
  color: var(--foreground);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.header h1 {
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
}
.eyebrow {
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.header p:not(.eyebrow),
.groupHeader > p,
.summary > p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.actions,
.exportActions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.project {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr 1.5fr;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--surface);
}
.specification {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--control-radius);
  background: var(--surface);
}
.specification summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.specification summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.specification p {
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.project > *,
.layout > *,
.candidates > * {
  min-width: 0;
}
.feedback {
  min-height: 20px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.error {
  padding: 12px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--destructive);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  color: var(--destructive);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 24px;
}
.groups {
  container-type: inline-size;
}
.group {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.groupHeader {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.groupHeader h2,
.summary h2 {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 24px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.candidates {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.candidate {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--surface);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.candidate[data-decision="preferred"] {
  border-color: var(--primary);
}
.candidateHeader {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 12px 4px;
}
.candidateHeader h3 {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.decision {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.candidate[data-decision="preferred"] .decision {
  color: var(--primary);
}
.description {
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.preview {
  height: 224px;
  padding: 12px;
  overflow: auto;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--background);
}
.candidateBody {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
}
.metadata {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
.metadata > div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.metadata dt {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.metadata dd {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.metadata code {
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
}
.summary {
  position: sticky;
  top: 80px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--surface);
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 96px);
  overflow: auto;
}
.summaryList {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.summaryList > li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.alternatives {
  padding: 0 12px 8px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.summary > .attention {
  color: var(--warning);
}
.handoffText summary {
  padding: 4px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.handoffText summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.handoffText textarea {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.summary > .boundary {
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
@container (max-width: 680px) {
  .candidates {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
@container component-selection (max-width: 1200px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .summary {
    position: static;
    max-height: none;
  }
}
@container component-selection (max-width: 720px) {
  .header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .project {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1279px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .summary {
    position: static;
    max-height: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .root {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .project {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
